MSME mantralay ne naee dilli sthit pragti maidan men aayojit tred pheyar men MSME paiveliyan ka udghatan kiya. is avsar par kendriy sukshm, laghu aur madhyam udyam mantri jitan ram manjhi ne rojgar srijan, paryavran sanrakshan aur bhartiy arthavyavastha men MSME kshetr ke yogdan par vistar se apne vichar rakhe.

ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
